registered_before: any Adult fit (frozen in SCIENCE_LOCK); executable: lra/family.py clause_outcome(), claim_status(), q_status(), overall_label(), status_suffix(), label_headline(); tested exhaustively in lra/tests/test_truth_table.py (whole table: claim statuses x Q x technical validity x engineering-gate verdict x pre-fit blocker)
agreement: PROTOCOL.md section 12 states exactly these rules; protocol text and executable must agree; a disagreement is a defect to disclose and resolve; no label edits after inner results
z_supplementary_definition: NormalDist().inv_cdf(0.975): nominal 95% intervals of the same-map D1 - D0 confidence contrasts (supplementary, never primary slots, never a verdict input), on the same 1,999 draws

clause_outcomes.PASS: the registered bound clears the target (lower> : lower bound > target; upper< : upper bound < target)
clause_outcomes.NOT_ESTABLISHED_PRECISION: the point estimate satisfies the target but the registered bound does not (assessment precision failure; NOT an established violation)
clause_outcomes.NOT_ESTABLISHED_POINT: the point estimate fails the target but the interval does not exclude the target on the failing side
clause_outcomes.MEASURED_VIOLATION: the opposite bound excludes the target on the failing side (a violation supported by the interval)
clause_outcomes.INVALID: any nonfinite point or bound (never dropped, never sorted as a success)

claim_status_rules_in_precedence_order: a failed required control (without an amendment that repairs it) -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID, root cause FAILED_REQUIRED_CONTROL
comparator technically failed or missing -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID, root cause INVALID_OR_MISSING_COMPARATOR

nominee technically failed (fit/admission failure, decision-preservation failure, non-estimable candidate, or an eligible nominee blocked only by a missing guard comparator) -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID with that root cause

no eligible nominee -> NOT_ESTABLISHED_NO_ELIGIBLE_NOMINEE, with the selection reason (ORDINARY_UTILITY_FAILURE, LOCAL_GUARD_FAILURE or CONSTRAINED_FIT_INFEASIBLE); the fixed fallback is DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY and can never pass
comparator candidates computed but none eligible -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID, root cause NO_ELIGIBLE_COMPARATOR (never a completed head-to-head negative)
outcomes empty -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID (NO_CLAUSES); outcomes not exactly the claim's registered 11 slots -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID (MISSING_SLOTS; the family is never shrunk)
any INVALID clause -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID, root cause NONFINITE_PRIMARY_QUANTITY

otherwise -> NOT_ESTABLISHED with every failing clause listed and classified; root cause MEASURED_VIOLATION_SUPPORTED_BY_BOUND if any failing clause is a measured violation, ASSESSMENT_PRECISION_FAILURE if every failing clause is a precision failure, else CLAUSE_NOT_ESTABLISHED
q_status_rules: U|DIRECT-TASK|i8o64 not ordinarily eligible on some seed or task -> NOT_ESTABLISHED_NO_ELIGIBLE_NOMINEE (ORDINARY_UTILITY_FAILURE); P34-P37 are scored DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY and can never pass
outcomes empty -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID (NO_CLAUSES); not exactly P34-P37 -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID (MISSING_SLOTS)

otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED, root cause as for claims: MEASURED_VIOLATION_SUPPORTED_BY_BOUND if any failing clause is a measured violation, ASSESSMENT_PRECISION_FAILURE if every failing clause is a precision failure, else CLAUSE_NOT_ESTABLISHED; failing clauses listed
engineering_gate_wiring: the overall label takes the NEW correctness-gate verdict (ENGINEERING_GATE_RESULT.json, read by lra.run.engineering_ready: verdict ENGINEERING_READY, bound in the latest named lock, on origin) as a REQUIRED argument with no default; lra.run (every Adult science stage), lra.eval_lock (technical_validity), lra.assess (open_assessment / verify_validity) and lra.infer (engineering_gate) all require ENGINEERING_READY and never hard-code readiness (finding F10)
overall_label_rules_in_precedence_order: 1. a pre-science blocker is NOT RUN, with every A / B / C / Q status NOT_RUN: the engineering-gate verdict ENGINEERING_BLOCKED -> ENGINEERING_BLOCKED_NOT_RUN; otherwise a pre-fit budget / admission blocker, or an engineering-gate verdict that is not a resolved registered verdict -> INCOMPLETE_NOT_RUN (<concrete reason>); all Adult claims NOT RUN; never an Adult negative

2. an unresolved GLOBAL technical failure after science begins (technical_valid False; see failure_scope) -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID; a separately valid Q (or any claim status) is displayed beside it but never replaces the headline

3. passing method components, joined with ' + ': A == PASS -> PRIVACY_RELEASE_DEVELOPMENT_CRITERION_MET (<family>; <construction: existing | calibrated | task-only | weighted | constrained>[; identical to privacy-untrained <ids>]) named by winning_family_naming; B == PASS -> CONSTRAINED_SEARCH_INCREMENT_ESTABLISHED (with the N* identical_to_untrained disclosure when present); C == PASS -> PAIRED_JOINT_INCREMENT_ESTABLISHED (with the J* disclosure when present)
4. no passing method claim, Q == PASS -> CONFIDENCE_FEASIBILITY_ESTABLISHED_NO_METHOD_CRITERION (prompt sec. 12 literal); incomplete method claims stay in the label's status suffix
5. no passing method claim, Q not PASS, any claim or Q INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID
6. otherwise (complete valid work, nothing passes) -> EXPERIMENTAL_NO_ADVANTAGE
status_suffix_rule: EVERY overall label ends with ' [A=<status>; B=<status>; C=<status>; Q=<status>]' (lra.family.status_suffix; finding F14), so no headline -- in particular a Q-only CONFIDENCE_FEASIBILITY label -- can conceal missing method work or a missing required comparison; lra.family.label_headline strips the suffix for display
display_rule: every claim status, its root cause and its failing clauses are always displayed beside the overall label; a legitimately passing claim may be reported even if a separate claim is incomplete, and both are shown

selection_reason_classes.FIT_OR_ADMISSION_FAILURE: a required unit (release or its inner audit) is missing / not hash-complete (did not fit or admit with parity); technical
selection_reason_classes.FIT_RECORD_TECHNICAL_FAILURE: a constrained fit record is missing, not hash-complete, unreadable, schema-incomplete (status not in {FEASIBLE, INFEASIBLE} or deployed.feasible not boolean) or names another configuration / seed on some seed; technical, never CONSTRAINED_FIT_INFEASIBLE (finding F01)
selection_reason_classes.DECISION_PRESERVATION_FAILURE: a U-derived candidate failed exact decision preservation on some seed (technical, never a shortfall)
selection_reason_classes.NON_ESTIMABLE_INNER_METRIC: a required inner field (AUC, accuracy, log loss, Brier, constant accuracy, excess, release identity) is missing or nonfinite, or token_states is not a finite positive integer for a code / not null for a continuous release (finding F06); technical
selection_reason_classes.ORDINARY_UTILITY_FAILURE: no candidate of the role is ordinarily eligible on every seed (selection outcome; fallback_class UTILITY)
selection_reason_classes.LOCAL_GUARD_FAILURE: ordinarily eligible candidates exist but none meets the local guards (selection outcome; fallback_class LOCAL_GUARD)
selection_reason_classes.MISSING_GUARD_COMPARATOR: a required guard comparator role has no valid nominee: INVALID when some candidate is eligible, with the strongest eligible candidate by the ordering keys as its DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY fallback (finding F04); fallback_class MISSING_COMPARATOR; the claim is INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID
selection_reason_classes.CONSTRAINED_FIT_INFEASIBLE: every candidate of a constrained role has a complete fit record that is not FEASIBLE with a feasible deployed release on some seed (infeasible under this registered decoder and search); a selection outcome (NOT_ESTABLISHED_NO_ELIGIBLE_NOMINEE; fallback_class UTILITY), never a population impossibility

fallback_classes.TECHNICAL: FIT_OR_ADMISSION_FAILURE, FIT_RECORD_TECHNICAL_FAILURE, DECISION_PRESERVATION_FAILURE, NON_ESTIMABLE_INNER_METRIC (no fallback; the evaluation lock refuses)

failure_scope.mapping: units of P* / T* -> A; N* / C* -> B; J* / C_pair* -> C; Q unit -> Q; U -> every claim and Q (global)

root_cause_reporting: beside the single root cause, lra.family.cause_by_kind() reports the worst outcome per clause kind (coalition, local, acc, logloss, brier, retain), e.g. 'MEASURED_VIOLATION_SUPPORTED_BY_BOUND[coalition]; ASSESSMENT_PRECISION_FAILURE[logloss]', so a measured pair violation is never read as an established confidence violation; reporting only, never changes a status
winning_family_naming: the label names the (family; construction) of ONE real representative of P*'s exact alias set (configurations whose DEPLOYED release -- tokens, decoded probabilities, decisions on OSF_DEFENSE_FIT + AUDIT_FIT + INNER_SELECTION rows and declared alphabets -- is byte-identical to P*'s on all three seeds): among the members in P*'s own candidate pool (the privacy-trained codes), the lowest construction rank (existing (D0) < calibrated (D1 fixed-map) < task-only (C-TASK) < weighted < constrained), then family rank (LOCAL < SEQ-12 = SEQ-21 < JOINT = JOINT-SINGLE < JOINT-PAIR), then configuration ID; the name is that member's own family and construction (never independent minima; never an '=' join); every alias is listed separately; privacy-untrained exact aliases are disclosed as '; identical to privacy-untrained <ids>' (no privacy-training credit without a changed release) (findings F02, F03, F09)
role_level_aliases: data-dependent role aliases between ANY two of P*, N*, J*, T*, C*, C_pair* and Q (e.g. P* == N*, N* == J*, P* == J*, P* == C*, N* == C*, C* == C_pair*, T* == C_pair*, T* == Q, P* == T* for an untrained alias): the same configuration, or two configurations that are exact deployed-release aliases on all three seeds (alias sets computed for every role, comparators and Q included). Same tokens with a different decoder are NOT aliases; canonical token renamings are recorded separately as informational equivalence. Recorded per slot in EVALUATION_LOCK and PRIMARY_ENDPOINTS (alias_of_by_role); slots are kept; prose never counts one comparison twice (findings F07, F11)
selection_reason_note: technical reasons of one role are joined with '+' when several apply (e.g. DECISION_PRESERVATION_FAILURE+NON_ESTIMABLE_INNER_METRIC); the claim root cause carries them verbatim

claims.A: P* vs T*: useful privacy release beyond strong compression
claims.B: N* vs C*: added value of constrained search beyond calibration and true-label weighted controls
claims.C: J* vs C_pair*: added value of paired joint search
claims.Q: fixed original D0 DIRECT-TASK i8o64: four original confidence bounds

interpretation: A passes alone: a useful privacy release on this reused development benchmark; no new-search or joint claim
B passes: the registered constrained search adds value over strong controls; novelty separately reviewed
C passes: evidence for the paired joint component; not a universal superiority theorem
a fitting-budget certificate does not imply a passing assessment clause
a point below a limit with an upper bound above it is unresolved preservation, not an established violation
a nominee release identical to a privacy-untrained release is reported as such; its claim is never credited to privacy training
not_implied_by_an_A_pass: a new algorithm in the literature

report_rules.decoder_sentence: the opening sentence 'Learning the probabilities [did/did not clearly] improve confidence' is decided by the registered identical-token pair on the scored list: the best D1 fixed-map privacy control vs its paired D0 release; paired per-task D1 - D0 log-loss and Brier differences on the assessment with the same bootstrap draws and the SUPPLEMENTARY nominal 95% z (lra.infer same_map_decoder_contrasts / decoder_ablation); 'did' iff all four upper bounds < 0, otherwise 'did not clearly'; scoped to those decoded maps on this development assessment
report_rules.same_map_contrasts: the same contrast is also reported, supplementary and scoped, for P* (nominee or fallback) and its same-map D0 version and for C-TASK and its same-map D0 version; the maps are named on INNER before the assessment; tokens are identical, so no contrast is information removal

historical.note: the predecessor (lcr) closed with its registered fixture gate GATE_NOT_MET and the label MECHANISM_GATE_NOT_MET; that verdict is preserved as a source fact (SOURCE_FIXTURE_GATE.json) and never becomes this study's launch verdict or label; the old gate_met wiring (lcr infer gate_met=True, lcr eval_lock FIXTURE_GATE.json GATE_MET) is removed in lra (finding F10)
historical.superseded_text: the inherited cbp text named roles C_rate / C_global, the reason HEADROOM_SELECTION_FAILURE and cbp.family.cause_by_kind; all are removed from the registered rules (findings F08, F12)
